payload.unit_title: R21 Major Project Consolidated Print Report (M2.3)
payload.objective: Evaluate next unit in dependency graph (M2.3) following M2.2 checkpoint completion and issue initial TASK_DISPATCH with strict design-system (<x-layouts.report-layout>) and anti-duplication constraints.
payload.explicit_request: Units M1.1, M2.1, and M2.2 are COMPLETED and checkpointed (current commit: 66b3310d). All dependencies for M2.3 are satisfied. Please evaluate M2.3 and issue the formal TASK_DISPATCH for M2.3. Every task must consider existing CampusLynk global shells (<x-layouts.report-layout>) and components (<x-ui.*>) to avoid duplication. Return decision: 'TASK_DISPATCH' with payload.task_dispatch.

payload.reason: M2.3 is the next dependency-satisfied critical unit: M2.2 is checkpointed and provides the required R21 Major Project workspace/backend foundation. Before any implementation, the architecture must be inspected read-only against the legacy consolidated print/report behavior, the existing CampusLynk report-layout shell, available x-ui components, and the M2.1/M2.2 contracts. Because this is an official institutional print artifact, the report must use x-layouts.report-layout and must not introduce duplicate print shells, table systems, modal systems, or ad-hoc styling. The first task is therefore analysis and decomposition only; implementation authority will be issued separately after review of the TASK_REPORT.

task_dispatch.objective: Perform a read-only architectural analysis of the R21 Major Project Consolidated Print Report and determine the concrete implementation slices required to migrate it into the existing CampusLynk report architecture.
instructions: Inspect the M2.3 legacy source views, routes, controller/report endpoints, related models and services, and any existing report-generation logic required to understand the consolidated print report.
Inspect the existing target <x-layouts.report-layout> implementation and its supported slots, print/A4 conventions, typography, spacing, page-break behavior, and available global x-ui.* components.
Inspect the completed M2.1 and M2.2 artifacts and identify the data/contracts already available for the R21 Major Project report so no duplicate backend or UI infrastructure is created.
Map the legacy consolidated report sections, data dependencies, calculations, tables, headers, footers, statutory/institutional fields, and print behavior to the modern CampusLynk architecture.
Determine whether the report should be implemented as one report view or decomposed into modular Blade partials; any Blade file over 500 lines must be decomposed.
Identify every required target file and classify each as new or existing modification. Do not assume implementation files until the repository has been inspected.
Produce a concrete implementation plan split into safe slices, with each slice having a bounded file whitelist, verification strategy, dependencies, and explicit stop conditions.
Identify any gaps, ambiguities, legacy behaviors that require architectural decisions, and risks involving data parity, report calculations, print pagination, or route/controller integration.
Return a TASK_REPORT only. Do not implement the migration.
constraints: READ-ONLY ANALYSIS ONLY; do not modify application files.
Do not modify routes, controllers, models, services, Blade views, migrations, tests, STATE.json, FEATURE_MATRIX.md, or any other repository files.
Do not execute database migrations, truncate/drop/reset database state, or perform destructive database operations.
Do not create a new print shell, report framework, table component, modal component, button system, or custom duplicate UI infrastructure.
The eventual report MUST use <x-layouts.report-layout> for official institutional A4 printing.
Reuse existing <x-ui.*> components where appropriate; do not introduce raw table/button/modal markup where an existing global component is applicable.
All eventual Blade files must remain at or below the 500-line ceiling.
Do not expand scope into M2.4 or unrelated migration units.
Do not commit or alter git state.
task_dispatch.expected_report: A read-only M2.3 architecture TASK_REPORT containing: legacy report source and relevant target files inspected; complete functional/report-section inventory; route/controller/model/service/data dependencies; existing report-layout and x-ui capabilities relevant to the report; mapping of legacy behavior to target architecture; proposed implementation slices with exact candidate file whitelists; data/calculation parity requirements; print/A4 and pagination requirements; tests and verification plan; risks/ambiguities; and the recommended first implementation slice for subsequent architect approval.
stop_conditions: Stop immediately if implementation changes would be required to continue analysis.
Stop after the architecture, dependency, and decomposition analysis is complete.
Do not create or modify any repository artifacts.
Return only the TASK_REPORT for architect review.
